notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 91 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/50NPk7xF3Tt6X3DVucE9jU?si=44d2b7d44a5a4aec) with @CourtProjects and @ImpetusAlways. First-choice PvE pick for sustained damage to Boss Spec enemies in end-game content. Twilight Oath starts in last place for stats amongst its peers, but it has one trick up its sleeve to make it useful for boss damage, if you don't already have a well-rolled special weapon for when you run out of heavy ammo. You'll need to start out by taming the wonky recoil with a Recoil Direction or Stability barrel perk. Tactical Mag, Appended Mag and Extended Mag all get you to the maximum of 7 shots - Tactical Mag adds some useful additional Stability too. You can use this with the trait combination of Envious Assassin, which can get 18 shots after 14 primary/heavy kills (and up to 21 if you reproc), together with Precision Instrument, which provides a scaling damage bonus of up to +25% damage on the sixth and every subsequent crit hit. The Advanced Reflexes origin trait is quite useful in PvE - when activated by an enemy hit, it adds +30 Handling for additional ready and ADS speed, together with a handy +20 Mobility, for 7.5s. Recommended MW: Stability, with a damage boosting (Boss or Taken Spec) mod. Tags: PvE, PvE-Boss, PvE-BossSpec, PvE-EndGame, PvE-God, M+KB, Controller

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Similarly to Retold Tale, Twilight Oath has PvE perks but not the best position. Envious Assassin is great for overfilling the magazine, and Vorpal Weapon will net you great damage. You can utilize the full extent of Precision Instrument, my biggest issue is the frame. Rapid-fire frame snipers are hard to utilize at max RPM and require a hard pull down to keep on target. With the crit box shrinking on some bosses and champions doing what champions want to do, it will be hard to continuously hit crits at max RPM. Otherwise it’s a pretty solid general use sniper." Recommended MW: Reload.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "All of the Dreaming City weapons have a special place in my heart. Twilight Oath is no exception, it was the sniper I mained until Revoker came out. I never used a Snapshot Sights and Opening Shot roll, but I think it would be fun. You’re going to need to split your stat investments between handling and range to make sure you can feel that 70 aim assist on those longer sightlines." Recommended MW: Range or Handling.

[YeezyGT's S16] [MW: Range] "Twilight Oath's re-issue is fairly strictly a PvP weapon - your best bet is Opening/No Distractions/Surplus with Snapshot Sights. Invest into Range for better aim assist at distance, and swap to a different Sniper if you see an enemy running Icefall Mantle. (Fun fact: Icefall Mantle tanks a 140RPM headshot on 4+ Resilience)" tags:pvp
Inspired by Destiny Massive Breakdowns Podcast 219. PvP first choice roll. Recommended MW: Range with Targeting Adjuster mod.
